select *from statuses
and content like concat("%",#{q},"%") and user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = 0
order by created_at desc

select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio from user_following f join users u on f.followee_id = u.id where f.follower_id = #{userId} and (#{keyword} is null or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by f.id desc

select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio from user_following f join users u on f.followee_id = u.id left join statuses s on f.followee_id = s.user_id and s.is_deleted = 0 where f.follower_id = #{userId} and (#{keyword} is null or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) group by u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio order by max(s.created_at) desc

select u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.bio from user_follower f join users u on f.follower_id = u.id where f.followee_id = #{userId} and (#{keyword} is null or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by f.id desc
